description: pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:610 — DeviationRunResult is a public struct with two pub Vec fields but is not marked #[non_exhaustive]. Adding a new field (e.g. suppressed: Vec<Finding> for a future Suppress-action audit path) would be a semver-breaking change. ValidatedPath in pkix-path has #[non_exhaustive] with explicit documentation of the stability guarantee. DeviationRunResult should follow the same pattern. Fix: add #[non_exhaustive] and document that callers should not use struct literal syntax to construct DeviationRunResult.
title: DeviationRunResult missing #[non_exhaustive]
